MediaClaw 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launch of a full-stack AI video content factory that transforms a single source video into dozens of branded, localized, platform-ready clips.
- Core features include AI-based brand/logo replacement, caption generation, voiceover separation and replacement, and anti-duplicate systems.
- Supports batch video production, producing multiple unique variants tailored for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin.
- In-app copywriting engine generates platform-specific, ad-ready captions and hooks.
- Automated export to multiple aspect ratios and platform specifications, with options for API and enterprise integration.
